sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Official, public rulebook pages or PDFs. Each item: {sport, url, kind: "html"|"pdf", source, slug, license_note, skip_patterns?: [regex]}. rule_id becomes "<slug>:<number>" (e.g. ittf:2.6.2). Leave empty to use the bundled sources.json.

prefill.source: The Laws of Table Tennis 2026-27 (ITTF Laws as published by Table Tennis England)
prefill.license_note: (c) ITTF / Table Tennis England. Public PDF; quoted briefly with a link.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on HTTP requests for the whole run (one request per source; nothing is followed).

user_agent.title: User agent
user_agent.description: Sent on every request. Keep it descriptive, with a contact URL.
